text: Ethics in AI is becoming a very important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we need to think about fairness. One major problem is bias, because AI can learn unfair patterns from data and treat some groups of people badly. Privacy is another serious concern, since these systems often collect and use personal information. Transparency also matters: people should understand how AI makes its choices. For all these reasons, responsible AI development is essential. Companies and governments must work together to create rules that protect everyone and make sure technology is used in a fair and honest way.
